PLC Singapore · AI says:

To use new pet food correctly for the best result, switch gradually over about 7 days:

Days 1–3: ~25% new food, 75% current food
Next few days: 50% new, 50% current
Then: 75% new, 25% current
By Day 7: 100% new food

A slower change may help if your pet has a sensitive stomach.
